items.name: Aubergine
items.role: The brand's primary surface and CTA color. Deep, warm purple with a hint of ruby — used on filled buttons, the featured pricing tier, the footer band, and the…

items.name: Aubergine Deep
items.role: A near-identical sibling of extracted from a different surface; treat as functionally equivalent.

items.name: Aubergine Press
items.role: Pressed-state lift of the primary, slightly lighter and warmer.

items.name: Link Blue
items.role: Inline link color — saturated, slightly warm blue. The only chromatic alternative to aubergine in body type.

items.name: Link Hover
items.role: A more saturated blue used on link hover state.

items.name: Canvas Cream
items.role: Warm off-white used on hero gradients and feature bands. Adds editorial warmth.

items.name: Canvas Lavender
items.role: Pale lavender tint used as the secondary-button surface and as a soft section band.

items.name: Surface Aubergine
items.role: The primary aubergine reused as a surface — featured pricing tier, footer, dark feature bands.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: 1px borders on cards and table dividers.

items.name: Ink
items.role: Primary body text on light surfaces. Just shy of pure black.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: Text on aubergine surfaces and filled CTAs.

items.name: On Aubergine Mute
items.role: Secondary text on aubergine surfaces — a desaturated mauve that reads as muted-light.
